verdict.rationale: Activepieces is open source on GitHub (MIT-licensed per community) and documents several self-hosting paths: a one-line install script, Docker Compose that generates config and secrets, and a single-container Docker option. Its docs also say it can run on your own infrastructure or entirely inside your own network, and a community user ran it locally with the published images. missing for 10: evidence of production-scale deployment guidance (e.g. Kubernetes/HA), and complete dev-from-source setup docs, which a hands-on user reported were missing.
